transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. — nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too, Doctor. I'm... well, I'm here because for months now I’ve been trying to get people to understand what's going on. It's my husband’s family. They're quietly messing with our money and our good name. 

I mean, I see it happening. Like, these little billing errors will just show up at my work—I do billing for a living, so I notice—or someone at our church will suddenly start acting really funny toward me out of nowhere. People try to tell me I'm wrong, and they pull up records or accounts to try and prove it's just a coincidence, but... no matter what paperwork anyone pulls up, I know it ties back to them. I just need someone to finally see what they're doing.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people do not?

No, nothing like that. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there, if that's what you mean. 

The things I'm seeing are real things, right in front of me. It's actual paperwork on my desk and real conversations with people at church. I'm just noticing what they're doing, that's all. I'm not imagining things.
Do you think there could be any other explanation for what’s been happening?

No, I really don't. I mean, I know how it sounds, but I've looked at this from every angle. 

It's just too consistent. Like I said, it's the little billing errors that keep showing up at my work—and I know my job, I know what a normal mistake looks like. These aren't normal. And then there's the people at church suddenly acting strange toward me. It all connects. 

People try to show me account records or tell me it's a misunderstanding, but they just don't see the whole picture. No matter what paperwork they pull up to try and explain it away, I know it all ties back to my husband's family. They're trying to ruin us financially and ruin our reputation, and I just don't see any other explanation for it.
How long have you been certain that your husband’s family is doing this to you?

It's been about nine months now. It all started right around the time we had some trouble with his family over money and, well, expectations around the holidays. That's when I first started noticing the pattern.
During these nine months, have you had a period of feeling unusually depressed or unusually energized, more than just feeling stressed about this situation?

No, I haven't. I mean, I get upset and stressed out because of what they're doing to us, obviously. But I haven't felt depressed. And I definitely haven't felt unusually energized or anything like that. I just feel like my normal self, really, just trying to handle a very difficult situation.
Have you ever had times when your thoughts felt very disorganized or hard to follow?

No, not at all. My thoughts are actually very clear. I mean, I have to be pretty organized for my job, keeping track of the accounts and everything. So, no, I don't ever feel like my thoughts are hard to follow. I know exactly what's going on.
Have you ever had a time when you believed other people could hear your thoughts or that your thoughts were being put into or taken out of your mind?

No, I haven't ever thought that. My thoughts are just my own. I mean, they are definitely interfering with my life and causing all these problems, but they aren't in my head or reading my mind. So, no, nothing like that.
Have you ever felt like your mind was being controlled by someone else?
No, never anything like that. I'm the one in control of my own mind. I mean, they do things to try and ruin my life, but they can't actually control my brain or what I do. I make my own decisions.
Have you ever believed that your husband’s family, or anyone else, was putting ideas into your mind or taking thoughts out of it?

No, like I was just saying, nobody is doing that. My husband's family... well, they do a lot of things to try and ruin things for me, but they can't get inside my head. They aren't putting ideas in there or taking anything out. My mind is just my own.
